query: Читай CSV-файлы из директории /data/input/orders/, оставляй только строки где поле status равно COMPLETED, пиши результат в /data/output/completed_orders.csv.

runs.yaml_pim:
flow:
  id: csv_order_processing
  name: Process Completed Orders
  description: Reads CSV files, filters by COMPLETED status, and writes results to
    a new CSV.
triggers:
- id: trigger_manual
  type: manual
  condition: on demand
sources:
- id: source_csv
  name: Read Orders CSV
  type: File
  location: /data/input/orders/
  connection:
    properties:
      format: csv
      recursive: 'false'
processing_elements:
- id: filter_completed
  name: Filter Completed Status
  operation: Filter
  config:
    condition: status == 'COMPLETED'
sinks:
- id: sink_csv
  name: Write Completed Orders
  type: File
  location: /data/output/completed_orders.csv
  connection:
    properties:
      format: csv
      write_mode: overwrite
processed_data:
- id: order_data
  format: csv
links:
- from_id: source_csv
  to_id: filter_completed
  data_ref: order_data
- from_id: filter_completed
  to_id: sink_csv
  data_ref: order_data

error.details:
Trigger(s) ['trigger_manual'] have type 'manual'.
The flow will NOT start automatically in NiFi — someone must press Run in the NiFi UI.
Change trigger type to 'schedule' or 'event' for production use.
